title: Extreme Nash Imbalance: >600x Overpowered Tilted Critic (D >> G)
intuition: Pairs a tiny 0.08x-compressed off-manifold generator (32x2) against a >600x larger 512x4 Fourier-3 critic initialized with a hostile upside-down linear tilt (~ -30 logit margins) on a 16-mode ring.
failure_mode: The overpowered critic immediately saturates margins and crushes generator gradients, leaving the tiny generator trapped far off-manifold in its initial corner.
protocol_notes: Tier-2 stretch task and Four Laws Adherence Law 2 anchor (1,600 updates).
